acceptanceCriteria: The upgrade acceptance harness configures repository-local Git identity before any commit and never writes global Git configuration.
The regression executes with isolated HOME/XDG and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and proves the clean-environment commit path succeeds.
Success and failure paths retain acceptance truth, emit cleanup evidence, and remove the exact temporary run root.
Existing release shell checks, documentation checks, and Rust workspace quality checks remain passing.
goal: Make the N-1 release acceptance harness self-contained and fail-closed in an isolated Git environment, then prove the fix with regression evidence.
intent: Prevent public-to-staged release upgrade acceptance from failing in clean CI because repository-local Git identity is missing.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the release upgrade regression with isolated HOME/XDG and GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null; commit after cloning a control repository and assert local identity is used.
Run existing upgrade acceptance failure-path assertions and verify acceptance truth, cleanup.json, and SHA256SUMS remain consistent.
